_note: Main weapons, weapons-and-loot §3.3 (22 kinds + stick). dmg/spd/reach multiply the body. rar c/r/e/l. price {} = run-only (drops only); no_drop = never drops (stick). mech = per-weapon mechanic id read by Player (WeaponMech); its numbers sit next to it. Resource keys: iron (болотное железо), resin (живица), frost (иней-камень), hearts (сердца чудищ).

koromyslo.name: Коромысло

oslop.name: Ослоп
